result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `PurchaseOrderStore.countPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`. Its count subquery now adds the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` condition. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I also updated that method's Javadoc.

I left the shared `FOR_WAREHOUSE_REGION_IN_PERIOD` fragment alone, because the per-country count and list still include cancelled orders. I changed the comment on `listForCountry` so it no longer says the per-rep counts include cancelled orders.
